jobs.title: Baseline and priority tracking
tasks: Record GSC baseline for priority URL groups.
Record SE Ranking issue count and keyword positions if a fresh export exists.
Confirm the two new calculator URLs are in sitemap.
Place new calculator URLs into the forced priority indexing queue.
Confirm tools hub links to business funding calculators and quizzes.

jobs.title: Indexation review
tasks: Review indexation status for priority tool, course, quiz, and money URLs.
Group URLs by indexed, discovered-not-indexed, crawled-not-indexed, unknown, canonical mismatch, and blocked.
Keep unknown/discovered priority URLs in the forced queue.
Confirm no important tools/course/quiz pages are orphaned.

jobs.title: Business funding internal link pass
tasks: Link business line of credit money page to the line-of-credit calculator.
Link small business loans page to business loan and commercial loan calculators.
Link SBA page to SBA calculator and guarantee fee calculator.
Link startup business loans page to readiness quiz and line-of-credit calculator.
Link equipment financing page to equipment calculator.
Link invoice factoring page to accounts receivable calculator.
Run build after changes.

jobs.title: SBA loan requirements exact-intent page
tasks: Build or improve page targeting SBA loan requirements.
Cover eligibility, documents, credit expectations, collateral, personal guarantees, SBA 7(a), SBA 504, and microloan differences.
Link to SBA loan calculator, guarantee fee calculator, readiness quiz, and best SBA loans.
Use FAQ schema if supported by the page type.
Run build after changes.

jobs.title: SBA loan rates exact-intent page
tasks: Build or improve page targeting SBA loan rates and SBA loan interest rates.
Avoid unsupported rate claims; use current official references if stating live rates.
Add questions around sba rates today, sba 7a loan interest rates, and average interest rate for sba loans.
Link to SBA loan calculator and guarantee fee calculator.
Run build after changes.

jobs.title: Technical and SERP quality check
tasks: Run build and SEO checks.
Check duplicate titles/descriptions for touched pages.
Check sitemap/robots conflicts.
Check rendered title/meta/canonical for new or changed pages.
Confirm no accidental noindex on tools/course/quiz/money pages.

jobs.title: Week 1 review
tasks: Pull GSC page/query data for priority groups.
Compare against Day 1 baseline.
Review SE Ranking issue delta.
Identify indexed pages, still-unknown pages, low CTR pages, wrong-intent pages, and pages needing more internal links.
Apply decision rules: title/meta for weak CTR, internal links for indexed-but-quiet, wait if indexing is technically clean.

jobs.title: Startup/no-revenue line of credit page
tasks: Build or improve targeted content for business line of credit for startup without revenue.
Include business loan with no revenue and related startup financing terms.
Explain limitations honestly: owner credit, bank activity, revenue, collateral, and alternatives.
Link to startup business loans, line-of-credit calculator, readiness quiz, business loan calculator, and bad-credit business loans.
Run build after changes.

jobs.title: Accounts receivable financing support
tasks: Review invoice factoring and accounts receivable calculator coverage.
Decide whether to create a separate accounts receivable financing guide/money page now or wait for GSC impressions.
If justified, target accounts receivable financing, accounts receivable loan, loans on accounts receivable, and financing accounts receivable.
Link to invoice factoring, working capital calculator, accounts receivable calculator, and small business loans.
Run build after changes if page/link changes are made.

jobs.title: Credit, cards, course, and quiz routing
tasks: Review whether credit repair, credit builder, credit card, quiz, course, and wellness assets link to one another naturally.
Add contextual links into credit fundamentals course, credit score simulator, borrowing power quiz, loan denial checker, credit repair qualify quiz, and relevant money pages.
Run build after changes.

jobs.title: Title and meta refinement from data
tasks: Pull GSC queries for URLs with impressions.
Compare query language to current titles/metas.
Rewrite titles/metas only where data shows mismatch or weak CTR.
Avoid duplicate metas across money/tool/support pages.
Run build after changes.

jobs.title: Competitor sitemap follow-up
tasks: Recheck Lendio, LendingTree, BestMoney, OnDeck, CreditSaint, and partner-engine competitors for exact page families.
Identify repeatable structures CreditDoc can copy: calculators, rates pages, requirements pages, best/product pages, answer clusters, and prequalification/readiness flows.
Map only the next 5 high-confidence gaps.

jobs.title: Indexation and crawl cleanup
tasks: Re-run priority indexation checks.
Confirm newly added pages are live 200, canonical to themselves, in sitemap, linked internally, not blocked, and queued/submitted where possible.
Check whether SE Ranking issues are real technical issues or crawler interpretation.
Keep important unknown URLs in the forced indexing queue.

jobs.title: Week 2 review and next sprint
tasks: Pull GSC and SE Ranking data again.
Compare Day 1, Day 7, and Day 14.
Mark each action as shipped, indexed, discovered, generating impressions, needs links, needs title/meta refinement, or wait for more data.
Prepare next two-week plan from actual movement.
